This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a "Frankenstein" Video Editor based in Brazil.

We are looking for a creative, analytical, and highly independent Video Editor to produce high-performing video advertisements by combining proven creative elements into fresh, engaging concepts. In this role, you will go beyond traditional editing, using performance data and creative insights to develop compelling visual narratives that drive advertising results. You will work with existing footage, winning ads, hooks, formats, and messaging to create original content that feels cohesive and strategically crafted. You will have the freedom to experiment with new creative approaches while continuously optimizing what already works. Working in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment, you will collaborate with a global team focused on innovation, creativity, and measurable growth. This is an opportunity to take ownership of the entire creative process and directly influence advertising performance.

lists.content:
• Analyze existing advertising campaigns and performance data to identify successful creatives, hooks, angles, storytelling techniques, and formats that can inspire new concepts.

  • Develop original "Frankenstein" ad concepts by combining proven elements from different videos, campaigns, and creative formats into cohesive, engaging advertisements.

  • Independently build creative strategies and visual narratives without relying on detailed storyboards or step-by-step instructions.

  • Monitor key advertising performance metrics, including hook and hold rates, audience retention, CTR, CPC, CPM, CPA, ROAS, and ad spend, to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Continuously experiment with new hooks, formats, storytelling approaches, and creative variations to improve campaign performance.

  • Turn creative concepts into polished, high-performing video advertisements using engaging visuals, dynamic pacing, captions, sound design, motion graphics, and AI-generated assets when appropriate.

  • Navigate large content libraries efficiently, identify reusable footage, and creatively repurpose existing assets.

  • Manage creative projects independently, deliver consistent batches of high-quality advertisements, incorporate feedback, and communicate the strategic reasoning behind creative decisions.

  • Stay informed about advertising trends, competitor strategies, emerging formats, and innovative creative techniques to bring fresh ideas to the team.

    • Requirements:

  • Proven experience in video editing, particularly creating performance-driven video advertisements for digital marketing campaigns.

  • Strong creative judgment and the ability to independently develop engaging concepts, original ideas, and compelling visual narratives.

  • Demonstrated ability to combine footage, hooks, messaging, angles, and creative elements from multiple sources into seamless and cohesive advertisements.

  • Strong understanding of performance marketing principles and the relationship between creative decisions and advertising results.

  • Experience analyzing advertising metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPM, CPA, ROAS, retention, and hook and hold rates to guide creative decisions.

  • Excellent video editing skills, including visual storytelling, pacing, sound design, captions, motion graphics, and creative transitions.

  • Resourcefulness and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work efficiently with extensive content libraries and limited creative direction.

  • A proactive, self-directed mindset with strong ownership of creative projects and the ability to manage multiple deliverables independently.

  • Creative curiosity and a willingness to explore emerging trends, experiment with new formats, and continuously improve advertising concepts.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain creative decisions clearly while collaborating with a fast-moving, international team.

  • Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and AI-generated visual assets is an advantage.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and market benchmarks.

  • Comprehensive benefits package.

  • Paid time off and company-observed holidays.

  • Fully remote work environment.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and career development.

  • Access to creative tools, resources, and training to support professional success.

  • Collaborative, inclusive, and supportive international team environment.

  • Opportunity to work on innovative advertising campaigns in a fast-growing, performance-driven business.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Mid-Level Software Engineer – Golang (Banking/Investments) based in Brazil.

We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join a team responsible for building and maintaining critical financial systems that power fixed-income investment products. In this role, you will contribute to the entire investment lifecycle, from product issuance and financial settlement to accurate interest calculations and maturity payments. You will develop and improve high-performance, mission-critical applications within a large-scale financial technology environment. Working with modern architectures and complex integrations, you will help ensure system reliability, security, scalability, and data integrity. You will collaborate closely with other engineers to deliver robust solutions, improve technical practices, and continuously evolve the platform. This is an excellent opportunity to work on challenging projects with a direct impact on the financial ecosystem.

lists.content:
• Design, develop, maintain, and evolve software solutions using Go (Golang), contributing to new features and improvements across mission-critical financial systems.
  • Build and optimize scalable, reliable, and high-performance applications that support fixed-income investment products and their financial operations.
  • Contribute to the entire investment lifecycle, including investment issuance, financial settlement, interest calculations, and maturity payments.
  • Ensure production systems meet demanding non-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, security, availability, resilience, and data integrity.
  • Monitor application performance and behavior after deployment, identifying potential issues and implementing improvements to ensure operational stability.
  • Develop and maintain microservices-based architectures, ensuring efficient communication and integration across the technology ecosystem.
  • Implement automated testing strategies and promote continuous code quality through best practices and code inspections.
  • Participate actively in code reviews, sharing technical knowledge and contributing to the continuous improvement of engineering standards.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date technical documentation to ensure traceability of software changes and architectural decisions.
  • Identify gaps in existing processes, systems, and architecture, proactively proposing innovative and effective solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineering colleagues to improve system reliability, technical efficiency, and the overall evolution of the platform.

    • Requirements:

  • Solid professional experience in software development using Go (Golang).
  • Strong commitment to software quality, including experience implementing automated tests and performing continuous code inspections.
  • Practical experience designing, developing, and maintaining microservices architectures.
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases, such as PostgreSQL and MySQL.
  • Understanding of software engineering principles, scalable system design, and application performance optimization.
  • Ability to identify technical and architectural challenges, question existing approaches, and proactively recommend improvements.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work on complex systems and technical challenges.
  • Adaptability and enthusiasm for learning new technologies, tools, and engineering practices.
  • Collaborative mindset and effective communication skills, with a willingness to participate in code reviews and share technical knowledge.

    • Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of or interest in the financial services industry, particularly fixed-income investments and financial settlement processes.
  • Experience working with public or private cloud platforms, such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or OpenStack.
  • Familiarity with messaging systems and event-driven architectures, including Kafka, RabbitMQ, ZeroMQ, or IBM MQ.
  • Knowledge of advanced architectural patterns and approaches, such as Event Sourcing, CQRS, Hexagonal Architecture, and Lambda Architecture.
  • Experience with non-relational databases (NoSQL) and data modeling.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools, preferably Azure DevOps.

    • Benefits:

  • Fixed salary.
  • Variable compensation package, which may include profit-sharing (PLR), long-term incentives (ILP), or commissions, depending on role eligibility.
  • Health and dental insurance with copayments. Copayments are waived for professionals with disabilities.
  • 24/7 virtual healthcare and telemedicine services.
  • Medication subsidy.
  • Meal and/or food allowance through Pluxee, subject to eligibility.
  • Childcare assistance for children up to 5 years and 11 months old.
  • Additional financial support for employees with children with disabilities.
  • Life insurance.
  • Fuel or commuting allowance, depending on eligibility.
  • Home office allowance for remote and hybrid employees.
  • Welcome package for new parents.
  • Access to SESC partner benefits, subject to eligibility.
  • Professional development opportunities through internal learning platforms and digital libraries.
  • Free emotional and psychological support through the Acolhe360º program.
  • Access to quick massage services and on-site medical facilities, subject to eligibility.
  • Optional additional benefits, including Wellhub, TotalPass, Pet Club, Flash, Férias&Co, public transportation allowance (VT), Allya, and educational partnerships.
  • Remote work opportunity within Brazil.
  • An inclusive workplace where all positions are open to professionals with disabilities.

lists.content:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to coordinate initiatives, manage dependencies, and ensure successful project delivery.
  • Provide constructive feedback, challenge existing approaches, and contribute to technical and architectural decisions.
  • Share technical expertise and promote knowledge development and engineering excellence within the team.
  • Independently define and deliver technical roadmaps for larger projects, including initiatives involving dependencies across multiple teams.
  • Develop clean, scalable, and maintainable software solutions using C# and established engineering practices.

    • Requirements:

  • Professional experience in software development using C#.
  • Strong knowledge of algorithms, data structures, design patterns, and SOLID principles.
  • Solid experience with unit and integration testing.
  • Proficiency with Git and familiarity with GitFlow workflows.
  • Knowledge of Docker and containerization technologies.
  • Experience with observability tools such as Elasticsearch and Datadog.
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-structured code.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and their practical application, particularly Kanban and/or Scrum.
  • Experience incorporating AI tools into software development workflows.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, technical autonomy, and the ability to make sound engineering decisions.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across teams and contribute to shared technical objectives.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Experience with public or private cloud platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud.
  • Knowledge of messaging technologies such as Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, or Kafka.
  • Familiarity with architectural patterns and approaches such as microservices, Event Sourcing, CQRS, and Hexagonal Architecture.
  • Experience with relational and non-relational database modeling.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD tools and practices, particularly Azure DevOps.
  • Interest in or previous experience within the financial services and payments industry.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Distribution/REX) based in Brazil.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to contribute to the development and evolution of high-impact digital products within the financial technology sector. In this role, you will work across mobile and web platforms, combining Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) for shared mobile logic and React for web applications. You will take ownership of technical initiatives from discovery through delivery, shaping architectural decisions and driving continuous improvements. Working closely with product, design, and backend teams, you will translate complex business requirements into reliable, intuitive, and high-performing solutions. This position offers significant technical autonomy, opportunities to influence product strategy, and the chance to contribute to scalable solutions in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

lists.content:
• Lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable, maintainable, and high-quality software solutions across mobile and web platforms.
  • Develop and maintain web applications using React and TypeScript, ensuring consistency, performance, accessibility, and a seamless user experience.
  • Build cross-platform mobile solutions using Kotlin Multiplatform, strategically sharing business logic between Android and iOS while preserving native performance and user experiences.
  • Drive technical discovery, propose innovative solutions, challenge existing approaches, and identify opportunities for continuous product and engineering improvements.
  • Ensure consistency in business logic, functionality, and design across mobile and web applications.
  • Implement and maintain complex business workflows involving commissions, partner activation, time-based conditions, and feature flags, ensuring accurate application behavior.
  • Make architectural and technical decisions that support scalability, maintainability, performance, and long-term product evolution.
  • Identify and proactively address technical risks, including performance bottlenecks, cross-platform compatibility issues, and technical debt.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and other stakeholders to align technical solutions with business objectives.
  • Establish and promote engineering best practices, including automated testing, code reviews, and collaborative development workflows.
  • Act as a technical reference for the team, mentoring less experienced engineers and influencing technical decisions across squads.

    • Requirements:

  • Solid professional experience developing web applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Strong experience in mobile development with Kotlin, including practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture principles and patterns, such as MVVM, Clean Architecture, and related design approaches.
  • Experience with state management, software design patterns, and building scalable application architectures.
  • Strong knowledge of automated testing, including unit, component, and integration testing.
  • Experience with code reviews, Git, and Gitflow or similar version control workflows.
  • Hands-on experience integrating REST APIs and implementing effective error handling and caching strategies.
  • Ability to independently lead complex technical initiatives, navigate ambiguity, and make sound architectural decisions with minimal supervision.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to anticipate technical challenges and balance engineering quality with business priorities.
  • Experience collaborating across multidisciplinary teams, influencing decisions beyond immediate team boundaries, and aligning technical, product, and design perspectives.
  • Excellent communication skills, with a proactive approach to sharing progress, identifying risks, and raising potential blockers.
  • Strong ownership mindset, collaborative attitude, and commitment to continuous learning and technical excellence.

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience with Compose Multiplatform, Jetpack Compose, or SwiftUI.
  • Familiarity with design systems and reusable component libraries.
  • Knowledge of web performance optimization, including Core Web Vitals, UX best practices, and accessibility standards.
  • Experience with production experimentation, A/B testing, product analytics, and tools such as Amplitude.
  • Previous experience in financial services, payment processing, or sales-oriented digital products.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for mobile and web applications.
  • Experience using AI-powered and agentic development tools to accelerate software delivery, support technical discovery, and drive continuous improvement.

    • Benefits:

  • Fixed salary.
  • Variable compensation package, which may include profit-sharing (PLR), long-term incentives (ILP), or commissions, depending on role eligibility.
  • Health and dental insurance with copayments. Copayments are waived for professionals with disabilities.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Manager based remotely in Brazil.

We are looking for a customer-focused Account Manager to guide homeowners through important decisions about improving their properties.
In this sales-focused role, you will manage customer relationships from initial qualification through to closing and service delivery.
You will use a consultative approach to understand customer needs, identify challenges, and recommend tailored solutions.
By combining strong communication skills with structured sales techniques, you will build trust and contribute directly to customer satisfaction and revenue growth.
You will manage a high-volume sales pipeline while collaborating with internal teams to ensure a smooth customer journey.
This opportunity offers comprehensive training, ongoing mentorship, and the chance to grow within a globally distributed, technology-driven environment.

lists.content:
As an Account Manager, you will take ownership of customer interactions and sales opportunities, ensuring that each prospect receives informed guidance and a positive experience. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Manage leads throughout the entire sales cycle, from qualification and initial contact to closing and service delivery.

  • Conduct outbound communications through phone calls, SMS, and email, while responding promptly to incoming customer inquiries.

  • Apply consultative sales methodologies, including SPIN or similar frameworks, to uncover customer needs and communicate the value of available solutions.

  • Build strong relationships with homeowners by understanding their personal objectives, property challenges, and expectations.

  • Recommend tailored solutions that improve customers' properties and support their lifestyle goals.

  • Maintain and manage a high-volume sales pipeline using CRM platforms and specialized sales tools, ensuring accurate records and timely follow-ups.

  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to provide a seamless customer experience.

  • Share customer feedback, market insights, and emerging trends with the Sales Team Leader.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of sales tools, training materials, and team workflows.

  • Participate in team knowledge-sharing activities and support a collaborative learning environment.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a persuasive and empathetic communicator with a strong consultative sales mindset and the ability to manage multiple opportunities independently. You should bring:

  • Experience in consultative sales, with exposure to both B2C and B2B environments.

  • A proven ability to manage a high-volume sales pipeline with accuracy, organization, and consistent follow-through.

  • Knowledge of structured sales methodologies, such as SPIN or comparable frameworks.

  • Strong communication and persuasion skills, with the ability to build trust, understand customer needs, and handle objections empathetically.

  • The ability to explain complex products or services clearly and help customers make informed decisions.

  • Good technical proficiency and the ability to work across multiple digital tools, such as Google Workspace, Slack, Pipedrive, Google Meet, and Front.

  • Self-discipline, initiative, and the ability to remain productive while working remotely in an evolving environment.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage customer interactions and competing priorities effectively.

    • Additional experience that would be advantageous includes:

  • Previous experience as an Account Manager within a sales or customer success team.

  • Exposure to both retail-based and remote sales environments.

  • Familiarity with structured workflows, CRM systems, and process management tools.

  • Experience supporting customers through post-sale transitions and service delivery.

  • The ability to identify recurring challenges, recognize patterns, and recommend process improvements.

  • Familiarity with the construction, home improvement, or home services industries.

    • Benefits

  • Compensation: $8 per hour plus 1.3% commission, with payments made through Upwork.

  • Paid bootcamp: A fully funded, immersive training program featuring one-on-one mentoring, practical exercises, and collaborative learning.

In this role, you will develop an intelligent solution that extracts business and technical requirements from legacy codebases and documentation, helping accelerate complex system modernization. You will take end-to-end ownership of the solution, from architecture and data pipelines to production-ready applications. Working with Python, React, LLMs, RAG architectures, and multi-agent systems, you will leverage cutting-edge AI technologies to solve real-world business challenges. You will operate within an agentic Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), using AI as a core driver of engineering and delivery. This position also offers the opportunity to provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and contribute to innovative AI engineering practices in an international environment.

lists.content:
• Lead the end-to-end development of AI-powered solutions, from architecture and technical design to implementation, testing, and production deployment, using an agentic SDLC approach.
  • Design and build agentic AI architectures, including LLM integrations through APIs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool orchestration, runtime frameworks, system prompts, and safety guardrails.
  • Develop and maintain context data pipelines using internal data sources and vector databases to provide AI agents with reliable, relevant, and high-quality information.
  • Build backend services and APIs using Python and develop user-facing applications with React.
  • Create, customize, and share reusable AI development assets, including agents, skills, subagents, commands, and development harnesses, to improve engineering productivity.
  • Evaluate and validate AI solutions through automated testing, evaluation frameworks (evals), and red-teaming practices to identify hallucinations, prompt injection vulnerabilities, and potential data leaks.
  • Critically assess AI-generated code and outputs, ensuring they meet technical standards, quality expectations, and business requirements.
  • Optimize token consumption and inference costs through effective context management, RAG strategies, and agent-call orchestration.
  • Implement observability across applications and agent workflows to monitor performance, behavior, output quality, and operational costs.
  • Act as a senior technical reference, leading complex technical discussions, reviewing code, and mentoring other engineers.
  • Collaborate with AI Deployment Engineers and AI Orchestrators to ensure solutions are production-ready and delivery remains predictable.
  • Apply ethical AI principles and ensure compliance with privacy, data security, and regulatory requirements.

  • Proven experience as a Senior AI Engineer, with a strong track record of building and deploying AI-powered applications in production environments.
  • Strong backend development skills in Python, including APIs, services, and data processing.
  • Solid frontend development experience with React.
  • Hands-on experience developing LLM-powered applications, including prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, tool orchestration, and multi-agent architectures.
  • Experience working with vector databases and context data pipelines.
  • Knowledge of AI evaluation methodologies, automated testing, probabilistic behavior assessment, and AI red-teaming practices.
  • Practical experience using AI coding agents and developing custom agents, skills, or commands to accelerate software delivery.
  • Strong software architecture and engineering fundamentals, including microservices, event-driven architectures, CI/CD, Test-Driven Development (TDD), and observability.
  • Experience with code analysis, document processing, parsing, or text extraction solutions.
  • Ability to provide technical leadership, conduct code reviews, solve complex engineering challenges, and mentor team members.
  • Fluent English proficiency (B2 level or higher), both written and spoken.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and effective communication skills.

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience analyzing, maintaining, or modernizing legacy codebases, including COBOL, Java, .NET, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of advanced RAG architectures and knowledge graphs.
  • Familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation tools.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience with model fine-tuning techniques.
  • Previous experience in financial services, banking, or the mortgage industry.

Working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams, you will drive projects from initial problem identification through implementation, documentation, and long-term adoption. This is an opportunity to shape how a growing international business operates while enjoying significant autonomy and ownership.

lists.content:

  • Lead the migration of meeting booking workflows to native HubSpot forms and standardize forms across the website.

  • Design and implement a consistent HubSpot segmentation structure to improve reporting, customer organization, and automated lead routing.

  • Integrate Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and Google Merchant Center with Claude to automate client account analysis, reporting, and alerts.

  • Identify and automate repetitive activities across client account management and sales operations.

  • Improve lead email performance by optimizing engagement, clicks, and response rates rather than focusing solely on sending volume.

  • Standardize and automate content auditing processes to ensure consistent quality and execution across teams.

  • Build automation systems supporting partnership management and joint venture operations.

  • Take ownership of an existing product, overseeing its management, development, and ongoing improvement.

  • Identify operational problems independently, define appropriate solutions, and translate business needs into actionable technical projects.

  • Build, test, debug, and deploy workflows, integrations, and tools using automation platforms, APIs, and AI-assisted development technologies.

  • Document processes, establish clear operating procedures, and ensure newly implemented systems are adopted and maintained over time.

  • Collaborate with sales, account management, operations, and technical teams to implement solutions and drive organizational adoption.

  • Potentially coordinate and support a small team of operations specialists while remaining directly involved in implementation and development.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical operations professional who combines strong problem-solving abilities with practical experience building automation systems, managing CRM environments, and deploying AI-powered workflows.   • Strong hands-on expertise with HubSpot, including workflows, integrations, CRM architecture, segmentation, and reporting.

  • Ability to read, understand, modify, and debug code, including through AI-assisted development tools.

  • Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude and Claude Code to build and deploy functional workflows, applications, or automation solutions.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify operational inefficiencies, define solutions independently, and take projects from concept to implementation.

  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, Google Workspace, Google Sheets, and business intelligence or reporting tools such as Looker.

  • Ability to work with tools such as ClickUp and Vercel, or quickly learn comparable technologies.

  • Experience troubleshooting complex workflows and identifying issues that may not be immediately visible through standard reporting or system alerts.

  • Excellent analytical thinking, organizational skills, and attention to detail.

  • Ability to work autonomously, prioritize competing initiatives, and make sound decisions with limited information.

  • Customer Experience & Relationship Management

  • Handle inbound calls and make outbound calls when customers need additional assistance.

  • Build and maintain relationships with customers and trade professionals through phone, email, chat, social media, and other communication channels.

  • Understand customer needs and project requirements, explain products and solutions clearly, and recommend appropriate next steps.

  • Adapt your communication style to different audiences, including architects, kitchen designers, electricians, retailers, homeowners, and other customer groups.

  • Respond to product-related and technical questions using internal resources and documentation, following up on commitments and involving qualified colleagues when necessary.

  • Identify recurring customer questions and opportunities to improve product communication.

  • Turn customer feedback and recurring questions into opportunities to improve marketing materials, educational resources, e-commerce content, and follow-up processes.

  • Collaborate with customer experience, marketing, e-commerce, and technology teams to create resources that address customer needs.

  • Identify gaps in existing content and contribute to developing new guides, tools, and educational materials.

  • Document relevant customer insights in shared knowledge systems to support future interactions and internal processes.

  • Lead and coordinate projects across customer experience, marketing, e-commerce, and technology.

  • Define project objectives, organize next steps, coordinate contributors, and keep initiatives progressing toward completion.

  • Communicate progress, keep stakeholders informed, and proactively identify and resolve blockers.

  • Take ownership of assigned projects from initial concept through execution and final review.

  • Evaluate outcomes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • Technology, AI & Process Improvement

  • Use and continuously improve the technology and AI tools supporting customer service and internal workflows.

  • Identify repetitive tasks, process gaps, and opportunities for automation.

  • Help define, test, and implement AI-powered tools, agents, and workflows that improve productivity and customer experience.

  • Work with colleagues to translate business needs into practical technology improvements.

  • Contribute relevant information to shared knowledge systems so employees and AI tools can access and use it effectively.

  • Stay curious about emerging technologies and proactively explore ways to make everyday work more efficient.

    • Requirements:

  • Previous experience in a customer-facing role, with a proven ability to build relationships and communicate effectively.

  • Strong interpersonal skills, including active listening, thoughtful questioning, and the ability to adapt communication to different audiences.

  • Confidence communicating with customers by phone, email, and social media platforms such as Instagram and Facebook.

  • Interest in learning about technical products and the ability to understand and explain basic electrical concepts, including amps, volts, and watts.

  • Strong spatial reasoning skills and comfort working with measurements, drawings, dimensions, and product specifications.

  • Strong project management and coordination skills, with the ability to organize details, collaborate across teams, and drive initiatives through completion.

  • Excellent organization and prioritization skills, including the ability to manage competing responsibilities and independently identify next steps.

  • Strong computer skills and confidence learning new software, systems, and digital tools.

  • Willingness to experiment with AI tools and workflows and identify opportunities to improve processes. An engineering or programming background is not required.

We are seeking an experienced Project / Delivery Manager to bring structure, predictability, and transparency to a global software product delivery environment. The role focuses on strengthening delivery operations, improving backlog quality, and ensuring commitments, decisions, and communications are clearly documented and consistently followed through. You will act as a trusted interface between global stakeholders, vendors, regional teams, and product leadership, filtering incoming demands and protecting leadership focus. This is an AI-intensive role where practical use of AI tools is expected to improve productivity, documentation quality, and delivery effectiveness.

lists.content:
• Own and maintain delivery cadences, including Scrum or Kanban ceremonies, across multiple time zones and culturally diverse teams.

  • Improve backlog quality by ensuring work items are clear, actionable, properly scoped, and aligned with agreed Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) standards.

  • Monitor delivery commitments, milestones, dependencies, and risks, ensuring progress updates are factual, precise, and supported by evidence.

  • Govern multi-vendor and outsourced delivery arrangements by tracking commitments, assessing performance through measurable data, and managing structured escalations.

  • Act as the primary filter between global demand and product leadership, evaluating incoming requests and ensuring only sufficiently defined and prioritized work reaches the team.

  • Protect delivery focus by challenging incomplete requests and preventing unplanned scope from entering active sprints.

  • Maintain clear, executive-ready documentation and communications so stakeholders can understand delivery status, decisions, and next steps without requiring repeated clarification.

  • Coordinate communications and operational alignment across global and regional teams, ensuring relevant information is shared consistently.

  • Work within an AI-enabled Notion workspace, using AI tools to accelerate workflows, improve documentation, and increase operational efficiency.

  • Develop a strong understanding of the product by actively exploring its application, back office, and reporting capabilities.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 8 years of experience in project or delivery management within software product organizations.

  • At least 3 years of experience working in multi-vendor or outsourced delivery environments.

  • Demonstrated ownership of Scrum or Kanban delivery practices across multiple time zones and cultures.

  • Proven ability to improve work-item quality, supported by concrete examples of backlog improvements and the implementation of Definition of Ready and Definition of Done standards.

  • Experience in vendor governance, including commitment tracking, data-driven performance management, and structured escalation.

  • Near-native written English, with the ability to produce precise, unambiguous, professional, and executive-ready documentation.

  • Strong analytical and structured reasoning skills, including the ability to identify unsupported updates, circular arguments, unclear commitments, and dates without actionable plans.

  • Advanced working knowledge of a work-tracking platform such as Jira or Azure DevOps.

  • Experience working in documentation-first environments; strong preference for Notion proficiency.

  • Practical AI fluency, with the ability to demonstrate workflows already automated or accelerated using AI and explain the measurable time or productivity savings.

  • Strong emotional maturity, discretion, and professionalism when handling sensitive commercial or organizational information.

  • A factual, objective communication style and the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders when requests do not meet delivery standards.

  • Curiosity and a product-oriented mindset, including willingness to use and understand the product directly rather than managing delivery processes in isolation.

  • Motivation to work in an AI-intensive environment and continuously develop practical AI capabilities.

  • Availability to maintain daily working-hour overlap with Central European Time (CET) and US Eastern Time, with occasional flexibility for Asia-Pacific (APAC) hours.

  • Dental insurance.

  • Meal and food allowances.

  • Extended paternity leave.

  • Gym and wellness partnerships through Wellhub (Gympass) and TotalPass.

  • Life insurance.

  • Continuous learning opportunities through a dedicated learning platform.

  • Online resources focused on physical, mental, and overall well-being.

  • Partnerships with online learning platforms.

  • Additional employee benefits and development resources.

In this role, you will join an Information Security Blue Team, helping protect corporate systems, applications, and endpoints against cybersecurity threats. You will support incident response activities, including alert triage, evidence collection, and investigation of security events under the guidance of experienced professionals. You will also monitor vulnerabilities, contribute to endpoint security management, and help ensure compliance with internal security controls. Working alongside SOC, Infrastructure, and other technical teams, you will participate in threat intelligence activities and security improvement initiatives. Additionally, you will contribute to technical documentation, security playbooks, and the evaluation of emerging technologies, including AI-powered solutions. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your cybersecurity expertise in a collaborative, fast-paced, and continuously evolving environment.

lists.content:
• Support the management of low-complexity security incidents, from initial alert triage and ticket registration through containment, investigation, eradication, and recovery, collecting evidence and documenting event timelines under the guidance of mid-level and senior team members.
  • Monitor application and endpoint vulnerability alerts, consolidate relevant information, coordinate remediation activities with responsible teams, and verify that corrective actions have been successfully implemented.
  • Assist with Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) management by maintaining security policies and endpoint coverage, documenting operational exceptions in coordination with the SOC, and opening technical support requests for maintenance and improvements.
  • Monitor non-compliance tickets generated by automated asset inventory audits and collaborate with Infrastructure teams to ensure that security controls are properly implemented and maintained.
  • Support external threat intelligence activities by monitoring and organizing relevant information about emerging threats and potential security risks.
  • Assist in the technical evaluation of new security tools and technologies, including Artificial Intelligence solutions, according to established assessment and approval criteria.
  • Contribute to the creation and maintenance of technical documentation, security procedures, runbooks, incident response playbooks, and lessons-learned reports.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity and IT teams to strengthen security operations, improve incident response processes, and maintain effective protection across the organization's technology environment.

    • Requirements:

  • Currently pursuing or holding a degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Basic knowledge of networking concepts and protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and HTTPS.
  • Familiarity with Windows, Linux, and macOS operating systems.
  • Basic understanding of cybersecurity incident response processes and vulnerability management, including vulnerability lifecycles, CVE, and CVSS.
  • Foundational knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and best practices, such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
  • Basic understanding of security principles and controls in public cloud environments.
  • Practical exposure to Blue Team activities through cybersecurity laboratories, hands-on exercises, or simulation platforms such as TryHackMe and LetsDefend.
  • Strong written communication skills, particularly when documenting security evidence, preparing reports, and maintaining technical procedures.
  • Analytical thinking, curiosity, attention to detail, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with different technical teams and communicate security-related information clearly.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Hands-on exposure to EDR solutions, vulnerability scanning tools, or cloud security technologies.
  • Familiarity with workflow automation tools and the use of Artificial Intelligence to automate operational tasks.
  • Knowledge of Information Security standards and best practices, including ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, and CIS Controls.
  • Familiarity with entry-level cybersecurity certifications, such as CompTIA Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC), or Blue Team Level 1.
  • Ability to adapt communication style to different audiences, explaining technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • Benefits:

  • Full-time employment under a formal Brazilian employment contract (CLT).
  • Remote work flexibility, allowing you to work from anywhere in Brazil.
  • Standard working schedule of 8 hours per day, Monday through Friday.
  • Opportunity to develop practical cybersecurity skills while working alongside experienced security professionals.
  • Exposure to incident response, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, and modern security technologies.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Development Analyst (Analista de Desenvolvimento Sr) based in Brazil.

As a Senior Development Analyst, you will play a key role in developing, maintaining, and evolving enterprise software solutions, with a particular focus on an operational CRM platform. You will contribute to omnichannel customer service experiences, ticket management, conversational workflows, marketing campaigns, and knowledge management systems. Working closely with technical leaders and multidisciplinary engineering teams, you will help design scalable backend services while ensuring software quality, security, performance, and reliability. You will also serve as a technical reference for junior and mid-level developers, promoting best practices, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. This role combines hands-on software engineering with technical leadership and architectural collaboration. You will join an innovation-driven environment that encourages experimentation, modern development practices, and the responsible use of AI-powered tools.

lists.content:
• Develop, maintain, and continuously improve enterprise software solutions based on business requirements and technical specifications, ensuring quality, security, and reliability.
  • Design, implement, and evolve backend services for an operational CRM platform, focusing on performance, scalability, reliability, and observability.
  • Contribute to the development of omnichannel customer service solutions, including ticket management, conversational workflows, marketing campaigns, and knowledge management functionalities.
  • Ensure that source code is organized, readable, maintainable, and aligned with software engineering best practices and established development standards.
  • Lead and promote unit testing, integration testing, and debugging activities to identify and resolve software defects and improve application quality.
  • Design and maintain efficient data models and high-quality SQL queries, functions, indexes, and reversible database migrations.
  • Develop and maintain integrations with external channels and systems, including messaging providers, ERP platforms, marketing tools, and internal business applications.
  • Implement reliable integration patterns, including idempotency, retry mechanisms, and deduplication, to ensure consistent data processing and system interoperability.
  • Write automated unit and integration tests as an integral part of the development lifecycle.
  • Conduct thorough code reviews, providing constructive feedback and ensuring technical consistency across the development team.
  • Collaborate with technical leaders in the design and definition of software architecture and scalable technical solutions.
  • Act as a technical reference for junior and mid-level developers, providing mentorship, guidance, and support for their professional development.
  • Lead technical discussions and team meetings, encouraging collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
  • Promote a culture of innovation by identifying opportunities to introduce new technologies, tools, and development practices.
  • Continuously expand technical knowledge and stay up to date with emerging technologies, software engineering methodologies, and industry trends.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools, such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, as productivity partners while maintaining technical ownership, code quality, and critical judgment over generated outputs.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 4 years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated senior-level expertise in building and maintaining medium- to large-scale enterprise applications.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Systems Analysis and Development, or a related field.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one established backend programming language, such as C#/.NET, Python, or Node.js with TypeScript, with the ability to quickly learn and adapt to additional technologies.
  • Advanced SQL knowledge, preferably with SQL Server and PostgreSQL, including relational database modeling, indexing strategies, execution plans, referential integrity, and concurrency management.
  • Strong understanding of Git and collaborative development workflows, including pull requests, code reviews, and version control best practices.
  • Experience designing and developing HTTP/REST APIs, including error handling, API versioning, and contract management.
  • Practical experience implementing automated testing as a standard part of the software development lifecycle.
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, scalable, and well-documented code while following established engineering standards.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools, such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent solutions, as part of daily development workflows.
  • Clear communication skills in Portuguese and the ability to read and understand technical documentation in English.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to identifying technical challenges and implementing effective solutions.
  • Good collaboration and mentoring skills, with the ability to support less experienced developers and contribute to technical discussions.

    • Nice to have:

  • Previous experience developing or maintaining CRM systems, contact center solutions, or omnichannel platforms.
  • Advanced PostgreSQL knowledge and familiarity with Change Data Capture (CDC) technologies such as Debezium and Kafka.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and distributed system integration patterns.
  • Familiarity with integrations involving WhatsApp Business, Meta platforms, Infobip, Emarsys, ERP systems, and internal tracking applications.
  • Experience working with monorepositories, trunk-based development, and feature flag strategies.
  • Knowledge of Supabase, PostgREST, Realtime capabilities, and workflow automation tools such as n8n.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Docker Compose, Helm, GitOps, and Azure DevOps.
  • Basic frontend development knowledge, particularly React and TypeScript, including tools and frameworks such as Vite and TanStack Start.
  • Experience contributing to software architecture decisions and technical modernization initiatives.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive salary aligned with market standards.
  • Food or meal allowance (Vale Alimentação or Vale Refeição).
  • Transportation allowance (Vale Transporte).

  • Access to the Dr. Alper healthtech platform.

  • TotalPass membership, providing access to a network of gyms and fitness facilities.
  • Educational assistance, subject to the applicable eligibility and reimbursement policies.
  • Career development opportunities through online learning platforms and corporate education programs.
  • Discounts on courses and educational programs through partnerships with academic institutions.
  • Participation in the Qualituran Quality of Life Program, focused on employee well-being.
  • Opportunities for continuous professional growth in a collaborative and innovation-oriented environment.
  • Remote working arrangement, offering flexibility and convenience.

In this role, you will play a key part in strengthening information security by ensuring robust identity and access governance practices across the organization. You will oversee identity lifecycle management, access reviews, privileged access controls, and security compliance initiatives. Working closely with business leaders, technical teams, and external providers, you will help ensure that access management processes are secure, efficient, and aligned with regulatory requirements. You will also contribute to the development of governance frameworks, process automation, and continuous improvement initiatives. This is an opportunity to influence security standards, mitigate operational risks, and promote a strong security culture within a collaborative and fast-paced environment. The position is fully remote and offers the opportunity to work on impactful security initiatives.

lists.content:
• Develop, review, and maintain Identity and Access Governance (IGA) policies, standards, procedures, and workflows, including process design and documentation using BPMN.

  • Lead monthly and quarterly access reviews, manage RBAC matrices, coordinate follow-ups with business leaders, and ensure proper documentation and retention of audit evidence.

  • Build and maintain system access matrices and Segregation of Duties (SoD) frameworks to prevent conflicts of interest and unauthorized access.

  • Support the integration and centralization of systems within IGA/IAM platforms by identifying business and application owners, conducting stakeholder interviews, and facilitating knowledge transfer and training.

  • Oversee password vaulting and Privileged Access Management (PAM) processes, including access matrices, license management, reporting, and training for administrators and end users.

  • Manage non-human identities (NHIs), including shared accounts, service accounts, AI identities, and the lifecycle of digital certificates.

  • Monitor the implementation and adoption of Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) controls across systems, coordinating with external providers when necessary.

  • Identify and address access discrepancies, including active accounts belonging to former employees and unauthorized permissions, escalating incidents when appropriate.

  • Monitor and report monthly Information Security Management System (ISMS) indicators while ensuring IGA compliance with PCI-DSS, SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001/27002, and Central Bank of Brazil regulation BCB 85/2021.

  • Support internal and external audits, as well as security committees, by providing evidence and expertise related to identity and access governance.

  • Automate recurring IGA activities, including access reviews, alerts, and reporting, using workflow automation tools such as n8n.

  • Promote security awareness and encourage the adoption of identity and access governance best practices across the organization.

    • Requirements:

  • Proven experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Single Sign-On (SSO), and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).

  • Hands-on experience implementing and maintaining Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) frameworks and Segregation of Duties (SoD) matrices.

  • Strong understanding of the identity lifecycle, including onboarding, role changes, offboarding, access reviews, and access certification processes.

  • Knowledge of privileged access management, shared accounts, service accounts, non-human identities, and AI-related identities.

  • Experience developing, documenting, and maintaining IAM policies, standards, procedures, and governance workflows.

  • Familiarity with IGA/IAM security controls and compliance requirements under PCI-DSS, ISO 27001/27002, and Brazilian Central Bank regulation BCB 85/2021.

  • Familiarity with IAM/IGA platforms, password vaulting solutions, and access management tools.

  • Basic understanding of cloud architecture and modern technology environments.

  • Excellent communication, active listening, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with business teams and leadership.

  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a proactive approach to identifying and mitigating security risks.

    • Nice to have:

  • Demonstrated experience managing PCI-DSS and SOX compliance controls within IAM/IGA environments.

  • Experience implementing SSO and PAM solutions, such as Senhasegura, and password vaulting platforms, such as Keeper.

  • Practical experience automating workflows with n8n and using collaboration and service management tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Zendesk.

  • Previous experience in financial institutions or payment companies regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil.

  • Professional certifications or specialized training in IAM, ISO 27001, or Information Security.

  • Full-time employment under a Brazilian CLT contract.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Mid-Level Implementation Analyst (Analista de Implantação PL) based in Brazil.

We are looking for a proactive and customer-oriented Mid-Level Implementation Analyst to lead the implementation of software solutions for clients in the e-commerce industry. In this role, you will be responsible for understanding business requirements, mapping operational processes, and configuring solutions to meet each client's specific needs. You will play a key role in ensuring smooth system implementations, from initial onboarding and project planning to testing, training, and final delivery. Working closely with customers and internal teams, you will help optimize workflows, improve operational efficiency, and maximize the value of technology solutions. This position also offers opportunities to contribute to continuous product improvements and support the development of less experienced team members. The ideal candidate combines technical knowledge, problem-solving abilities, and a strong sense of ownership in a collaborative and innovation-driven environment.

lists.content:
• Welcome newly assigned clients and manage the implementation process from onboarding through project completion, using only company-authorized or management-approved tools.
  • Prepare, coordinate, and monitor standardized documentation and agreements that guide implementation activities, ensuring transparency and alignment among all stakeholders.
  • Conduct business process discovery and mapping to understand client requirements, operational workflows, and project needs.
  • Develop and validate project Business Blueprints, ensuring alignment between client expectations, business requirements, and proposed technical solutions.
  • Configure and test software products to ensure they meet client-specific requirements and operate effectively.
  • Coordinate and monitor unit and integration testing, identifying inconsistencies, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring the quality and reliability of implemented solutions.
  • Deliver client training and guidance to ensure users can confidently and independently operate the implemented systems.
  • Manage software and service implementation projects, facilitating smooth transitions while minimizing operational disruptions and maximizing customer satisfaction.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous product and process improvements by gathering client feedback, documenting requirements, and monitoring enhancement requests through delivery.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to generate additional value for clients through innovative solutions and operational improvements.
  • Provide guidance and support to less experienced team members when needed, contributing to knowledge sharing and overall team development.

    • Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Previous experience managing software implementation projects, providing user support, and actively participating in system configuration and testing.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets.
  • Familiarity with generative AI tools and workflow automation platforms, particularly n8n.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand business processes and translate operational requirements into technical solutions.
  • Excellent communication and customer relationship skills, with the ability to interact effectively with different stakeholders.
  • Proactive mindset, adaptability, organizational skills, and a strong sense of ownership.
  • Ability to manage multiple activities, prioritize deadlines, and work collaboratively while maintaining a customer-focused approach.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Strong knowledge of SAP Business One (SAP B1) workflows, particularly Sales, Tax, Finance, Inventory, and Business Partners.
  • Experience with e-commerce platforms and online marketplaces.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, and Postman.
  • Previous experience in technology companies, software implementation, or e-commerce operations.

    • Benefits:

    Available from Day One:

  • Comprehensive health insurance through Bradesco Saúde Top, with no copayments or waiting periods.
  • Dental insurance through Odontoprev, with no copayments or waiting periods.
  • Flexible benefits allowance of BRL 500 per month.
  • Meal or food allowance of BRL 30 per working day.
  • Transportation allowance or fuel assistance.
  • Extended maternity and paternity leave.
  • Life insurance.
  • Teladoc access, including convenient mental health and therapy services.
  • Wellhub (formerly Gympass) membership for fitness and wellness activities.
  • SESC membership, providing access to cultural, leisure, and recreational services.
  • Educational partnerships offering exclusive discounts on courses at FAE and PUCPR.

    • Available After 90 Days:

  • Birthday day off.
  • Exclusive discounts on bringIT products.

    • Additional Details:

  • Full-time employment under a Brazilian formal employment contract (CLT).
  • Remote work model.
  • Inclusive workplace, with opportunities also open to People with Disabilities (PwD).

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analista de Infraestrutura - DBRE Sênior (Senior Infrastructure Analyst – Database Reliability Engineering) based in Brazil.

As a Senior Infrastructure Analyst specializing in Database Reliability Engineering (DBRE), you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining highly available, scalable, and secure database environments. You will contribute to the reliability and continuous evolution of technology products by implementing infrastructure automation, observability, and database performance improvements. Working across cloud and private cloud environments, you will help ensure that critical data platforms can support growing customer bases and high transaction volumes. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams, lead technical initiatives, and establish best practices for SQL and NoSQL database infrastructure. This role combines hands-on technical expertise, strategic thinking, and operational ownership in a collaborative, remote-first technology environment. It is an excellent opportunity to influence infrastructure architecture and strengthen the reliability of business-critical systems.

lists.content:
• Plan and technically lead infrastructure and database reliability projects in collaboration with engineering and technology teams.
  • Design and implement infrastructure improvements focused on availability, scalability, performance, reliability, and security.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools and modern DevOps practices.
  • Implement, maintain, and continuously improve database capacity and availability monitoring systems.
  • Define, establish, and promote best practices for SQL and NoSQL database clusters, ensuring consistency, performance, and operational reliability.
  • Plan database capacity and infrastructure growth to accommodate increasing customer demand, data volumes, and transaction loads.
  • Design, build, and maintain highly scalable database environments capable of supporting large-scale production workloads.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve production incidents, identifying root causes and implementing preventive measures.
  • Develop proactive monitoring systems and alerts based on service symptoms, performance indicators, and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
  • Act as a technical reference for the team, sharing knowledge, mentoring colleagues, and encouraging continuous improvement.
  • Document technical processes, infrastructure configurations, and operational solutions to promote standardization, knowledge sharing, and automation.
  • Manage database-related suppliers, service providers, and consulting contracts, ensuring the quality and effectiveness of external services.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to continuously improve infrastructure architecture, operational processes, and database reliability.

    • Requirements:

  • Must be currently residing in Brazil and eligible for employment under Brazilian labor regulations (CLT).
  • Proven experience working with cloud providers such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience managing private cloud environments, particularly VMware.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including Terraform, Ansible, and GitLab.
  • Strong database administration experience across SQL technologies, particularly PostgreSQL and MySQL.
  • Experience managing NoSQL databases such as DocumentDB, DynamoDB, and MongoDB.
  • Solid knowledge of Linux operating systems, including Red Hat, Debian, and Ubuntu.
  • Practical experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Thanos, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch, and Zabbix.
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using Bash, Shell, or other relevant programming languages.
  • Experience designing and maintaining reliable, scalable infrastructure capable of supporting high-volume production environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting and incident management skills, with the ability to investigate complex infrastructure and database issues.
  • Ability to establish technical standards, implement automation strategies, and improve infrastructure reliability.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to share technical knowledge and work effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Creative and proactive mindset, demonstrating curiosity, adaptability, and a genuine interest in learning and adopting new technologies.
  • Ability to take ownership of technical challenges, work autonomously, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote work: Work from anywhere in Brazil, with a flexible working schedule.
  • Flexible working arrangements: Remote work policies that support temporary relocation and greater work-life balance.
  • Home office allowance: R$1,500 to support the setup and improvement of your home workspace.
  • Monthly remote work allowance: R$250 per month, with the option to allocate R$50 toward a private pension plan.
  • Meal and flexible benefits: R$988 through Alelo Tudo, available as meal vouchers, food allowances, or flexible benefits.
  • Healthcare coverage: Medical and dental insurance with no copayment for employees, with the possibility of adding dependents.
  • Life insurance: Additional financial protection for you and your family.
  • Telemedicine: Access to remote medical consultations and specialized healthcare services.
  • Wellness programs: Gympass membership, sports and nutrition coaching, and free telepsychology services for employees and their dependents.
  • Birthday benefit: An additional day off to celebrate your birthday.
  • Family support: Extended maternity and paternity leave, pregnancy support, and childcare assistance for children up to 71 months old.
  • Coworking access: Partnership with Woba, providing access to coworking spaces throughout Brazil.
  • Professional development: Access to a dedicated Learning Hub with resources and programs to support continuous learning and career development.
  • Internal mobility: Opportunities to explore different roles and career paths within the organization.
  • Performance incentives: Participation in the company's profit-sharing program.
  • International collaboration: Opportunities to connect and exchange knowledge with colleagues across different countries.
  • Collaborative culture: An inclusive and supportive environment that values diversity, transparency, open communication, autonomy, and continuous improvement.
  • Career growth: Opportunities to contribute to innovative technology projects while developing your technical expertise and professional potential.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analista de Integração SAP x ONESOURCE Global Trade based in Brazil.

This is an exciting opportunity for a mid-to-senior-level integration professional to work on complex enterprise technology projects connecting SAP environments with global trade management solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining integrations between SAP ECC/S/4HANA and Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE Global Trade (OSGT), ensuring data consistency and operational efficiency. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, SAP specialists, and international teams to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions. The position offers exposure to international trade, customs operations, logistics, and enterprise system architecture. You will also contribute to system implementations, migrations, testing, and continuous improvement initiatives while leveraging modern integration technologies and AI-powered tools. This opportunity is ideal for someone with strong technical expertise, analytical thinking, and a customer-oriented approach.

lists.content:
• Analyze, design, implement, and maintain integrations between SAP ECC/S/4HANA and Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE Global Trade (OSGT).
  • Gather and analyze business requirements in collaboration with business departments, SAP teams, and international trade specialists.
  • Map and document import, export, logistics, procurement, sales, and customs processes to ensure accurate system integration.
  • Develop functional and technical specifications, including field mappings, data transformation rules, integration workflows, and exception-handling procedures.
  • Integrate SAP MM, SD, and FI modules using technologies and protocols such as IDoc, BAPI, RFC, REST/SOAP APIs, and middleware platforms.
  • Participate in the implementation, enhancement, migration, and ongoing support of system interfaces and integration solutions.
  • Execute System Integration Testing (SIT), support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and validate end-to-end business processes.
  • Investigate and resolve integration failures, data inconsistencies, communication issues, and production incidents.
  • Support Brazilian foreign trade and customs processes, including DUIMP, NPI, and other applicable customs obligations.
  • Collaborate with clients, technology providers, Thomson Reuters specialists, and technical and functional teams to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Maintain accurate technical and functional documentation, ensuring traceability and knowledge sharing.
  • Participate in agile planning, effort estimation, technical discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Leverage AI-powered tools to support technical analysis, documentation, testing, and process automation.
  • For senior-level professionals, provide technical leadership, define integration solutions, and mentor less experienced team members.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in enterprise systems integration for mid-level candidates, or 5+ years for senior-level candidates, preferably within SAP environments.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA.
  • Good knowledge of SAP MM, SD, and FI modules and their integration requirements.
  • Experience with SAP integration technologies and protocols, including IDoc/ALE, BAPI/RFC, REST/SOAP APIs, XML, and JSON.
  • Familiarity with SAP middleware and integration platforms such as SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI, or SAP Integration Suite.
  • Proven experience analyzing interfaces, mapping data flows, and preparing functional and technical specifications.
  • Knowledge of international trade processes, including import, export, logistics, and customs operations.
  • Experience with integration testing, troubleshooting, production support, and incident resolution.

  • Test application records, interactions, interfaces, filters, exports, and business processing rules.

  • Validate management platforms across product modules and operational workflows involving equipment monitored through mining control applications.

  • Assess application interfaces, registration processes, management features, communication flows, synchronization, geolocation, integration services, responsiveness, usability, and performance.

    • Requirements

  • Degree, technical qualification, or technologist education in a relevant field.

  • Advanced proficiency in JIRA for test management, defect tracking, and workflow organization.

  • Intermediate knowledge of API testing using Postman or equivalent tools.

  • Advanced Excel skills, with the ability to analyze and compare large datasets.

  • Ability to investigate large volumes of information and identify inconsistencies, data quality issues, and unexpected results.

  • Knowledge of operational indicators and KPIs used in mining operations.

  • Analytical, critical, and detail-oriented mindset, with a strong commitment to software quality and reliability.

  • Curiosity and persistence when investigating application issues, validating results, and identifying potential improvements.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and communicate findings clearly.

  • Experience with functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing.

  • Knowledge of SQL and relational databases, preferably Microsoft SQL Server.

  • Familiarity with Python programming.

You will work with cloud platforms, container orchestration, and Infrastructure as Code to build scalable and secure environments. lists.content:

  • Implement and maintain containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Integrate DevSecOps practices and Shift Left Security principles into development and deployment workflows.

  • Incorporate security tools such as SAST, DAST, and SCA solutions into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Monitor infrastructure and application performance, identify bottlenecks, and optimize resource utilization.

  • Manage deployment, security, and performance issues, ensuring reliable and efficient operations.

  • Support cloud security initiatives, particularly in Azure environments, and contribute to identity and secrets management using IAM and Key Vault.

  • Bachelor's degree or technologist qualification in Information Technology, Computer Networks, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Analysis and Development, Management Processes, or a related field. Relevant certifications may also be considered.

  • Strong professional experience designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.

  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent CI/CD platforms.

  • Knowledge of cloud security practices and cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure; AWS experience is also relevant.

  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration.

  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM Templates.

  • Experience implementing DevSecOps practices, particularly Shift Left Security.

  • Familiarity with application security tools and solutions, including SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx, and other SAST, DAST, or SCA platforms.

  • Knowledge of vulnerability management, security risk analysis, identity management (IAM), and secrets management using tools such as Azure Key Vault.

  • Understanding of web application architecture and front-end and back-end development concepts.

  • Strong sense of responsibility and commitment to data quality, integrity, accuracy, and confidentiality.
